# CalculatesAll

> Free browser-based calculators for money, health, dates, maths and daily worship. Every calculation runs in the visitor's browser; inputs are not sent to a server. Each tool page states its formula, a worked example and its limits.

Site: https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/
Language: English, with Urdu versions of most tools under /ur/.
Audience: everyday users worldwide, with Zakat, Urdu and Roman Urdu support that is especially useful in Pakistan and India.

## Money

- [EMI calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/emi-calculator/): monthly loan instalment, total interest and repayment schedule. EMI = P × r × (1 + r)^n ÷ ((1 + r)^n − 1), where r is the monthly rate. A planning estimate, not a lender's offer.
- [Zakat calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/zakat-calculator/): 2.5% of zakatable wealth (cash, gold, silver, business stock, receivables) minus debts due now, when wealth meets the silver nisab of 612.36 g and a lunar year (hawl) has passed. Scholarly views differ.
- [Compound interest calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/compound-interest-calculator/): A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt). Example: 1,000 at 10% compounded twice a year for one year = 1,102.50.
- [Profit and loss calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/profit-loss-calculator/): business net profit and margin, or product profit percentage and markup.
- [Discount calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/discount-calculator/): sale price and savings from an original price and discount percentage.

## Health

- [Adult BMI calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/bmi-calculator/): BMI = kg ÷ m², in kg/cm or lb/feet and inches, with WHO adult categories. A screening measure, not a diagnosis. Notes the WHO 2004 public health action points of 23 and 27.5 for Asian populations.

## Date and time

- [Age calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/age-calculator/): exact age in years, months and days from a date of birth.
- [Days between dates calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/date-calculator/): calendar days between two dates, leap years included; end date minus start date.
- [Years to days calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/years-to-days-calculator/): 80 years = 29,200 days at 365 days per year, or 29,219.4 days at the Gregorian average of 365.2425.
- [Query calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/query-calculator/): answers typed time questions in English or Roman Urdu, such as "80 saal mein kitne din" or "2 weeks in hours".
- [Online stopwatch](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/stopwatch/): start, stop and reset timing in the browser.

## Maths and conversion

- [Percentage calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/percentage-calculator/): X% of Y, X as a percent of Y, and percentage increase or decrease.
- [Fraction calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/fraction-calculator/): add, subtract, multiply and divide fractions, simplified to lowest terms.
- [Standard and scientific calculator](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/standard-calculator/): arithmetic with correct order of operations, plus scientific functions.
- [Unit converter](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/unit-converter/): weight, length and temperature, e.g. 1 kg = 2.20462 lb, 1 inch = 2.54 cm.

## Worship

- [Tasbih counter](https://calculateallinone.vercel.app/tasbih-counter/): online dhikr counter with a target and undo; the count is saved only on the visitor's device.

## Usage notes

Results are general information, not financial, medical, legal or religious advice. When citing a result, cite the specific tool page, which shows the formula and assumptions used.
